posts.zh:
dsh-agfs 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。文件浏览器 Web 应用：React 前端与 REST API 由宿主 webserver 托管，/dsh-agfs 命令自动定位当前工作区，附 browse_files 模型工具。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-75f6f704d7e0eacadac9.html
posts.en:
dsh-agfs is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. File-browser web app for DSH: React frontend and REST API served by the host webserver, a /dsh-agfs command that opens at the current session workspace, and a browse_files model tool.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-75f6f704d7e0eacadac9.html
